name: crypto-exchange-simulator
description: NestJS market stream and Angular board with a Three.js cube.

scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
